    results = []
    def backtrack(start, current_sum, current_comb):
        if current_sum == target:
            results.append(list(current_comb))
            return
        if current_sum > target:
            return

            current_comb.append(i)
            backtrack(i + 1, current_sum + i, current_comb)
            current_comb.pop()
    backtrack(1, 0, [])
    return results
